annotations.title: What weather stations measure near a place

description: What the weather stations near a place in the Alps measure now: temperature, snow depth, fresh snow, wind and gusts, each with the time of the measurement, and optionally the last days. Measured, not forecast, at the place and elevation of the station. Stations are chosen by distance and elevation difference, like in the topo^alpin app. Say which station, its elevation, how far away it is and when it measured: a station measures at its own place and elevation, not at the destination. A value of null means nothing current, never zero.

elevationM.description: The elevation that matters, if not the one of the place itself.

history.description: Also the last days per station, one line per day. Default false.

lat.description: Latitude, WGS 84. topo^alpin covers the Alps only.

placeId.description: When query matched several places, the placeId of the one the user means, from that list. Give it together with the same query.

query.description: Name of a summit, hut, pass or town.

name: station_observations

appUrl.description: Opens this place in the topo^alpin app.

dataStale.description: True: the data is older than its source is refreshed, or the source reports a fault. Say that it may be outdated. null: unknown, not fresh.

dataUpdatedAt.description: When the data behind this answer was produced (ISO 8601, UTC; a date for a fixed release). With several sources, the oldest. null: unknown.

disclaimer.description: Pass this on with every measurement.

elevationM.description: The elevation stations were chosen for.

elevationNotice.description: Present where a station measures far above or below the elevation asked. Pass it on.

elevationSource.description: Where elevationM comes from: input (given), place (of the place found) or terrain (our terrain model at the point). null: no elevation known.

missing.description: Present where there is no station. Pass it on.

more.description: Present where limit cut the list: there are more. Say so, or call again.

alternatives.description: Other places or areas the query may mean, each with how to ask for it: the same query with its placeId, lat and lon, or query.

label.description: Check it: a wrong place gives wrong stations.

partialMatch.description: No place has the name asked for; this one has a longer name that contains it. Name the place you used, and ask the user if they may mean another.

type.description: peak, saddle, alpine_hut, wilderness_hut, shelter, tour_place (where our tours start or end), town, or point where lat and lon were given.

sources.description: Name these when using the data.

stations.description: Best match first, by distance and elevation difference.

appUrl.description: Opens this station in the topo^alpin app. Give it with the station.

elevationDifferenceM.description: Station elevation minus the elevation asked for; positive: the station lies higher.

elevationM.description: Where the station measures, not the elevation asked for.

estimated.description: The fresh snow is estimated from the rise of the snow depth, not measured: noise or drifting snow can look like fresh snow. Say that it is an estimate.

history.description: The last days, if asked for. Empty if no history is available.

partialDay.description: Today, only the hours until now: its minimum and maximum are not those of the day.

humidityPct.description: value null: no current value, so it is unknown now, not zero. at: when the station last measured it, even if too old to show.

precipitationLastHourMm.description: value null: no current value, so it is unknown now, not zero. at: when the station last measured it, even if too old to show.

provider.description: Who operates the station. Name it.

snowDepthCm.description: value null: no current value, so it is unknown now, not zero. at: when the station last measured it, even if too old to show.

temperatureC.description: value null: no current value, so it is unknown now, not zero. at: when the station last measured it, even if too old to show.
